_comment: Models Salik serves through POST /v1/chat/completions and lists at GET /v1/models. `provider` is which backend owns `upstreamModel` (ollama | anthropic | openai) — ollama/openai need no translation (both already speak OpenAI's chat completions dialect), anthropic goes through src/providers/anthropic/. `fallback` is this model's own one-hop fallback; anything that omits it uses `defaultFallback` instead. Run `bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test` after editing — src/types.ts's parseModelRegistry validates this at startup and refuses to start on a dangling/self-referential fallback.
